_meta.description: Seed primitives for STREET family — framed as gallery-level neo-expressionist work (Basquiat, Haring) at full aesthetic weight. Explicitly EXCLUDES: handwritten words/text (AI generates random copy), spray-paint graffiti clichés, subway-tag wannabe aesthetics. Symbol-based iconography only. Kanye/Elon-tier monumental minimalism and Basquiat/Haring's actual gallery work. All entries tagged family=street.
_meta.loaded_by: core/prompt_alchemy.py at import time; merged into PRIMITIVES dict alongside PHOTO_EDITORIAL seeds.
_meta.coexistence_note: Existing TREATMENTS dict has basquiat, haring, graffiti_simple as monolithic fallbacks. New PRIMITIVES below enable compositional mode for STREET family.
design_principles: No handwritten words or text generation. AI cannot know what word is contextually correct, defaults to random cringe.
Symbols only (crown, skull, halo, ©, arrow, figure). Shapes carry meaning without literal text.
No graffiti-coded aesthetics (spray paint on walls, subway tags, aged tag layers). Gallery-level medium only.
Monumental, minimal, concept-driven. Basquiat's canvases hang in the Whitney. Frame accordingly.

crown_and_skull_focal.name: Crown and Skull Focal
crown_and_skull_focal.prompt_snippet: single central subject with a three-point crown above and an anatomical-study skull adjacent or overlapping, composition anchored on this iconographic pairing, monumental focal weight
crown_and_skull_focal.negative: multiple subjects, decorative crown, cartoon skull, busy background

monolithic_single_form.name: Monolithic Single Form
monolithic_single_form.prompt_snippet: one massive sculptural subject positioned dead center with architectural weight, occupying two-thirds of the frame, treated as a monument, commanding presence
monolithic_single_form.negative: small subject, cluttered, multiple competing elements

whited_out_revision.name: Whited-Out Revision
whited_out_revision.prompt_snippet: earlier marks and shapes partially painted over in thick white paint, ghosts of prior gestures visible through the white, revision itself becomes the aesthetic, Basquiat's overpaint technique
whited_out_revision.negative: pristine first-pass painting, no revision, clean surface

edge_to_edge_density.name: Edge-to-Edge Density
edge_to_edge_density.prompt_snippet: dense field of gestural marks and symbolic shapes extending fully to every edge, all-over composition with no negative space, no singular focal point, activated surface
edge_to_edge_density.negative: negative space, centered subject, clean empty areas

dancing_figure_radiant.name: Dancing Figure with Radiant Lines
dancing_figure_radiant.prompt_snippet: single simple figure caught mid-motion, short bold radiating lines emanating from the body to suggest energy and movement, centered composition
dancing_figure_radiant.negative: static figure, detailed anatomy, no motion indication

oil_stick_on_raw_canvas.name: Oil Stick on Raw Canvas
oil_stick_on_raw_canvas.prompt_snippet: rendered in oil stick marks on raw unprimed linen canvas, visible canvas weave between marks, waxy pigment texture, exposed ground, museum-quality Basquiat medium
oil_stick_on_raw_canvas.negative: digital finish, primed smooth surface, fully covered canvas

oil_on_primed_linen.name: Oil on Primed Linen
oil_on_primed_linen.prompt_snippet: oil paint applied to primed linen canvas with mixed brush and oil stick, visible brushwork, deliberate mark-making, Basquiat's later-career gallery medium
oil_on_primed_linen.negative: acrylic plastic sheen, digital flat fill, no visible brushwork

marker_on_cardboard.name: Marker on Cardboard
marker_on_cardboard.prompt_snippet: thick black marker strokes on corrugated cardboard, cardboard flute texture beneath, some ink bleeding into corrugation, raw studio-floor quality
marker_on_cardboard.negative: thin pen, smooth white paper, digital line

acrylic_drip_on_canvas.name: Acrylic Drip on Canvas
acrylic_drip_on_canvas.prompt_snippet: acrylic paint with visible brushstrokes, intentional vertical drips of wet paint running down from fresh marks, canvas texture at edges, gestural control
acrylic_drip_on_canvas.negative: flat digital fill, no visible medium

pastel_on_kraft.name: Oil Pastel on Kraft Paper
pastel_on_kraft.prompt_snippet: oil pastel smearing and layered on brown kraft paper, rich pigment buildup, paper texture showing through, gallery-level works-on-paper medium
pastel_on_kraft.negative: spray paint, digital fill, clean lined drawing

basquiat_primary_on_black.name: Basquiat Primaries
basquiat_primary_on_black.prompt_snippet: raw primary color palette of red, yellow, blue, and black, applied flatly, neo-expressionist color ethos, unmixed pigment
basquiat_primary_on_black.negative: muted pastels, gradient blending, realistic skin tones

haring_pop_primaries.name: Haring Pop Primaries
haring_pop_primaries.prompt_snippet: bold pop primary palette — red, yellow, blue, green — applied as flat saturated fills on black or white ground

monochrome_high_contrast.name: Monochrome High Contrast
monochrome_high_contrast.prompt_snippet: pure black marks on white ground or pure white on black, high contrast with no grey tones, single-ink clarity
monochrome_high_contrast.negative: grey tones, color accents, soft shading

raw_canvas_earth_tones.name: Raw Canvas Earth Tones
raw_canvas_earth_tones.prompt_snippet: natural linen canvas color as the dominant ground, earth-tone marks in ochre, burnt umber, raw sienna, with occasional pops of red or black
raw_canvas_earth_tones.negative: saturated pop colors, pure white background, neon

crown_motif.name: Three-Point Crown
crown_motif.prompt_snippet: three-point crown symbol rendered with quick gestural marks, sitting above or on the primary subject, Basquiat crown iconography, symbol only
crown_motif.negative: photorealistic crown, ornate metal crown, detailed jewels

skull_motif.name: Anatomical Study Skull
skull_motif.prompt_snippet: human skull rendered as anatomical-study drawing with gestural quick marks, sketched as if from a medical textbook but raw, integrated into composition
skull_motif.negative: Halloween cartoon skull, decorative sugar skull, photorealistic

radiant_baby.name: Radiant Baby
radiant_baby.prompt_snippet: simple crawling baby figure with short bold lines radiating outward from its body, Keith Haring iconography, symbol only

barking_dog.name: Barking Dog
barking_dog.prompt_snippet: three-legged barking dog figure in bold simple outline, short motion lines near mouth, Haring-adjacent iconography, flat profile view

halo_icon.name: Halo Icon
halo_icon.prompt_snippet: simple halo ring drawn in a single gesture above a figure's head, uneven circle, deliberate imperfection, ironic-sacred framing
halo_icon.negative: gilded baroque halo, perfect geometric circle, religious icon painting

copyright_mark.name: Copyright Mark
copyright_mark.prompt_snippet: copyright symbol (©) placed incongruously in the composition, recontextualized commercial iconography as symbol not text
copyright_mark.negative: printed corporate logo, polished branding, slick vector

primitive_figure.name: Primitive Figure
primitive_figure.prompt_snippet: abstracted human figure with stick-like limbs and a tribal-mask face, Basquiat's recurring figure language, raw gestural construction
primitive_figure.negative: anatomically correct figure, polished illustration, cartoon character

arrow_gesture.name: Arrow Gesture
arrow_gesture.prompt_snippet: short bold arrow drawn in a single gestural stroke, pointing into empty space or toward another element, no text attached
arrow_gesture.negative: diagram arrow with label, polished vector arrow, directional road sign

paint_drip.name: Vertical Paint Drip
paint_drip.prompt_snippet: clear vertical runs of wet paint dripping from fresh marks, gravity visible in the medium, imperfection as evidence of process
paint_drip.negative: dry controlled paint, no drip, clean edges

whitewash_revision.name: Whitewash Revision
whitewash_revision.prompt_snippet: sections of the composition painted over in thick white, earlier marks ghosted beneath the white layer, visible edit history, Basquiat's overpaint as concept
whitewash_revision.negative: pristine first-draft finish, no correction visible

canvas_staple_showing.name: Canvas Staples Showing
canvas_staple_showing.prompt_snippet: raw linen canvas wraps around stretcher bars with visible staples along the edges, unprimed rough edge, studio-rawness as gallery aesthetic
canvas_staple_showing.negative: finished framed artwork, clean gallery presentation with frame

aged_patina.name: Aged Patina
aged_patina.prompt_snippet: surface carries history through wear — slight stains, aged yellowing of canvas or paper, evidence of handling and time, without graffiti layers
aged_patina.negative: pristine new surface, graffiti tags over old work, manufactured aging

gallery_mounted_canvas.name: Gallery Mounted Canvas
gallery_mounted_canvas.prompt_snippet: raw canvas hung on a white gallery wall, single dramatic light from above, artwork presented in contemporary art context, wooden floor below, museum-quality framing
gallery_mounted_canvas.negative: street context, cluttered studio, outdoor wall setting

sacred_white_room.name: Sacred White Room
sacred_white_room.prompt_snippet: vast minimalist white room with polished concrete floor, singular artwork installed with monumental weight, DONDA-era Yeezy-compound austerity, architectural sacredness
sacred_white_room.negative: decorated gallery, multiple artworks, warm cozy lighting

studio_floor_in_progress.name: Studio Floor In Progress
studio_floor_in_progress.prompt_snippet: raw work laid flat on studio floor, paint cans and oil sticks scattered around, in-process evidence, working document energy, no gallery polish yet
studio_floor_in_progress.negative: finished framed wall-hung piece, pristine studio, staged photograph
